profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a Toronto-based public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions. According to its site, it engineers, designs, and manufactures infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud data centers, and serves what it calls high-growth markets through a global network.

The company's stated position centers on enabling critical data center infrastructure for AI and cloud workloads rather than on end-user AI products. No specific products, MCP servers, or lawsuits involving the company appear in the available records.
